finding: Goal subscribed to EventSource.onmessage while cloud task endpoint emits named progress events; named events were not rendered. CloudSseHub Lagged errors were also silently ignored.
changes: Goal panel listens for both default message and named progress events.
Cloud event receiver emits stream_gap with task_id, skipped_events, and recovery guidance, then closes the stream.
Extracted the per-task broadcast ring capacity into a named constant.
CloudSseHub assigns a monotonic per-task sequence and emits standard SSE id fields.
GET cloud task events honors Last-Event-ID and replays only later retained frames; bounded-history gaps and unknown task IDs are explicit.
Goal EventSource stays open across transient errors for native cursor-based reconnect and closes on terminal/not-found frames.
Cloud task SSE hub registration occurs synchronously after persistence and before HTTP exposes task_id, allowing early subscribers to wait for first progress.
Completed cursors receive stream_complete to prevent an empty-stream EventSource reconnect loop.
